lesson.uz:
Do bloki tanani avval bajaradi, shartni keyin tekshiradi. Shart True bo‘lsa takrorlanadi. Shu sababli tana kamida bir marta bajariladi.
Kiritishni tekshirishda Input’ni Do ichiga qo‘ying; qiymat yaroqsiz ekan, takrorlang. Urinishlar hisoblagichiga qabul qilingan oxirgi kiritish ham kiradimi, shartdan tekshiring. Ushbu mashqlarda kiritish oqimi tugashidan oldin to‘xtash sharti bajariladi.
lesson.en:
Do executes its body first and checks the condition afterward. It repeats while the condition is True, so it always runs at least once.
For input validation, place Input inside Do and repeat while the value is invalid. Check whether the successful final entry counts as an attempt. These inputs always reach the stopping condition.
